# Mohamed Omar // The Growth Architect

> Last updated: 2026-10-16

Mohamed Omar is a Growth Architect based in Cairo, Egypt. He builds growth systems for eCommerce and SaaS brands in Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Egypt, and runs white-label growth operations for agencies.

## Services
- Growth systems: finds where revenue stalls when the channel is healthy, then rebuilds offer, funnel and measurement as one system. Includes paid media across KSA, UAE and Egypt and AI-run reporting, content and campaign operations.
- White-label growth operations for agencies: the agency keeps its brand and clients; Mohamed runs the infrastructure and operations behind them. Live in 30 days, cancel anytime, full data transfer.

## Background
- Education: Cairo University; UNSW Sydney.
- Currently building Etlaala (travel), Grow Digital (agency) and Grow Edge (training).
- Etlaala result: from a 70,000 SAR monthly deficit to 1,000,000 SAR cumulative net profit over 12 months. Self-reported from internal records.
